diagnostics.OKA-E-REQUEST: Malformed asset transfer, duplicate asset identity, invalid digest/base64 or transport shape
diagnostics.OKA-E-RESOURCE: Transport byte, count or response limit exceeded
diagnostics.OKL-E-ASSET-CLOSURE: Missing/extra/conflicting source image requirements, nonliteral image pin or wrong bundle profile
diagnostics.OKL-E-PNG: Unsupported, malformed, nonopaque or incorrectly bounded PNG image
diagnostics.OKL-E-TEXTURE-MAPPING: Nonfinite, rank-deficient or out-of-bounds affine planar mapping or UV value
diagnostics.OKL-E-TEXTURE-REGION: Invalid wrapper, unknown/empty material binding, unsupported primitive or nonopaque textured factor
diagnostics.OKL-E-TYPE: Incorrect constructor nominal type or unit
diagnostics.OKL-E-REVISION: Stale source/asset edit precondition or incompatible atomic edit
diagnostics.OKL-E-RESOURCE: Current source/host/caller execution or existing numeric limit exceeded
diagnostics.OKE-E-TEXTURE: Supplied GLB texture accessor, image identity, sampler, material reference or appearance provenance differs

legacy_diagnostics: All earlier versions and inherited error rules retain their meanings
